briefing: Listen up, recruit! In the field, you can't always wait for user input. Sometimes, you need system parameters to be pre-set for rapid deployment. Mastering default states is crucial for efficient data capture.
objective: Configure the specified input elements to activate their default states without manual intervention.

test_assertions: Your first radio button on your form should be checked by default.
Your first checkbox on your form should be checked by default.

hints: Remember the 'checked' attribute? It's your key to pre-setting these controls.
Target the *first* radio and *first* checkbox in the data stream.
Don't mess with the labels, just the input's default state.
original_fcc_title: Check Radio Buttons and Checkboxes by Default
